command: bash -c for fault in "s/rescan = (a_max - uut \* u_plus) > /rescan = (a_max) > /" "s|f = (uut - rl \* uut) / (1 - uut) \* rolling|f = (uut - rl * uut) / (1 - uut) * rolling * 1.5|g"; do sed "$fault" analysis/insertion_alpha.py > analysis/_fault_order.py; echo "fault: $fault; lines changed: $(diff analysis/insertion_alpha.py analysis/_fault_order.py | grep -c "^>")"; python3 -I analysis/_fault_order.py --random-order 3000 2 | head -1; done; rm -f analysis/_fault_order.py; true
role: development machine: counters only, no timings
